senses.en: a toxic nonmetallic element related to sulfur and tellurium; occurs in several allotropic forms; a stable grey metallike allotrope conducts electricity better in the light than in the dark and is used in photocells; occurs in sulfide ores (as pyrite)
senses.zh: 一种与硫和碲同族的有毒非金属元素，具有多种同素异形体；稳定的灰色金属状异形体在光照下比黑暗中更易导电，可用于光电池，存在于黄铁矿等硫化物矿石中。

senses.en: the compass point midway between south and east; at 135 degrees
senses.zh: 指南针位于南向东中间; 位于135度
